text:
marta: quick ping — PR #5953 (rename RequestId -> RequestID + formatter exception for proto tags) needs a second approval. gofumpt CI is failing, but it's because of a one-off proto tag ordering that lints differently. Can someone take a look? @alex @sam

alex: taking a look now. can you paste the failing snippet?

marta: pasted snippet:
```
type KVCache struct {
    RequestId string `json:"request_id" protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=request_id"`
    Value []byte `json:"value" protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=value"`
}
```
CI error: gofumpt wants RequestID and protobuf tag placement. I intentionally kept `request_id` json tag for backward compat.

alex: hmm. rename is fine but we need to preserve json tag. i'd do:
```
RequestID string `json:"request_id" protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=request_id,json=request_id"`
```
also run `gofumpt -w` and CI should pick it up. :+1: 

sam: I can push a small cleanup in ~30m. will run formatter and add a short note in PR description. @jen FYI re merge window

jen: heads up — we're frozen for the next 4 hours for the release. if this lands before freeze ends it's ok, otherwise hold until post-release. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: build/test #5953 — gofumpt failed on files: ./pkg/kv/cache.go (line 12). See https://ci.example.com/build/5953/output

sam: ack. i'll try to land within the window; if not, i'll push branch `pr-5953-gofmt` and request merge after release.

marta: thanks all. @alex could you leave the second approval when you confirm the small commit? I'll add label `format-exception` and short rationale in PR body. :shipit:
